task.source: Development task with fixed target, tolerance and scoring; historical tasks are unchanged

recipes.novelty: Scenario/recipe combinations untested; weight itself may be historical.
recipes.selection_rationale: Disposition: retain the registered conditional pair (0.075, 0.15; terminal 0.05) as the concrete future comparison, but defer executing any screening preview; the frozen evidence does not support treating the screen as discriminating. (1) Local reference exists only on two development intervals (0.0005→0.00025→0.000125), measured uncertainty ≈1.5e-6 m position and ≈2.8e-5 m/s speed, explicitly not a proven error bound or backend accuracy. Retrospective screening returned abstained=true: history075 was predicted_safe yet observed violating (a false-safe), eligibility accuracy among resolved 0.5, no false rejection. The predicted ranking gap is −2.66e-6 m/s against an unchanged 1e-4 direction-neutral margin, so the verdict is unresolved and resolved ranking coverage is 0. Cost is adverse: preview 694.4 s exceeds complete-evaluation 605.9 s, with zero realized or hypothetical savings. The incumbent completes accurately (terminal error 0.00270 m; sampled settling passed at 0.00273 m / 0.01275 m/s) but missed all 35 deadlines, converged no updates, mean update 8.5 s, and real_time_demonstrated=false. (2) Three tiers differ in resolution. The shared-input .01 endpoint (identity 661f70b2, identical recorded tensions, one computation referenced by both cases) is a deterministic integration: differences reflect model/projection, not objective weight, and scatter is ~1e-6 m. Own-history command separation appears only at transient scale: independent histories give historical max speeds 0.02329 vs 0.01294 m/s (~1e-2 m/s apart), yet holding metrics coincide (5.32e-4 vs 5.31e-4 m; 8.689e-3 vs 8.686e-3 m/s). Weight-preview separation at the .20-scale comparison (0.075/0.15) is likewise unresolved, and the holding-entry decomposition warns coupled state/input histories preclude unique causal attribution, its residual mixing projection, model and numerical effects. (3) The one shared original .00–.01 fixed-input refinement is informative for numerical self-consistency and projection sanity (rate projection residual ≈1.98 rad/m·s at endpoint) but near-uninformative for screening: a shared input cannot rank candidates. (4) I retain a concrete conditional pair rather than claim new evidence. The reset-clock scenarios (incumbent_checkpoint_20/30_new_clock; terminal 0.05), where new MjData resets integrator caches and controller state, are explicitly not historical warm continuation; the .3–.31 held-tension interval is same-clock continuation but pre-step held input, not a controller preview. Executing them is deferred (preview_attempts=0). (5) This is research judgment, not validated screening capability: one pair, no confidence bound, no generalization.

rules.abstention: Incomplete/nonfinite/infeasible history, position violation, or speed gap <=1e-4: abstain. Resolved history rank is a testable forecast, not a proven safe rejection.
rules.constraint_handling: Position or terminal failure makes eligibility unresolved; forecast speed <=.02 is predicted-safe, otherwise predicted-violating. Always evaluate both candidates.
rules.local_direction: Compare predicted change to projected initial speed, observed change to observed initial speed. Absolute change <=1e-4 is neutral; predicted change within numerical uncertainty of +/-1e-4 is indeterminate.
rules.original_gates: Accurate local numerics, useful prospective full-task discrimination/order, broader repeatability and real-time operation remain required. No threshold is relaxed.
rules.primary_objective: Lowest sampled maximum holding speed, conditional on predicted terminal and holding position feasibility.
rules.screening_usefulness: Universal abstention fails useful screening; report pairwise order errors, resolved coverage, accuracy, false rejection and false-safe counts.
